name: 11/15 Legion 2
rem:
• Rally leaders: use the 2K gem buffs if possible (attack, lethality, defence, health, deployment).
• Keep at least 2 players on buildings 1, 2 and 4.
• If 3 or 7 is hit, focus on recapturing. Never trade a core building for kills.
• Reinforce immediately when called. Join your assigned pair — don't wander.
• Garrison leaders: do not abandon buildings, appoint a strong garrison captain before leaving.
Joiners
• Keep scanning the entire map: when a building flips sides, grab the scattered loot before the enemy does.
• Send any unused weak march to gather at the Undercellars when they open.
• Don't leave troops at home. Keep all marches busy.

groups.note: PAPA, run for it with attack formation (speed it up); if you get inside, your whole team follows you with defense. Meow, defend it with your best defensive heroes and gear. PAPA, if you fail to take it, call a 1-min rally. PAPA, after you hand the garrison to Meow, teleport and help MTP at Sanctum — near enemy, and send one defensive march back to Royal Stables (speed it up)!

Scervany, run for it with attack formation (speed it up); if you get inside, your whole team follows you with defense. Orion, defend it with your best defensive heroes and gear. Scervany, if you fail to take it, call a 1-min rally. Scervany, after you hand the garrison to Orion, teleport and help firebaugh at Sanctum — near home, and send one defensive march back to Bell Tower (speed it up)!

MTP, run for it with attack formation (speed it up); if you get inside, your whole team follows you with defense. Thanoss, defend it with your best defensive heroes and gear. MTP, if you fail to take it, call a 1-min rally. All 3 of you there: reinforce yourselves with a full defensive march before you start attacking the Abbeys. MTP, after you hand the garrison to Thanoss, start burning enemy towns around you with your strongest march — PAPA helps you: attack the same target at the same time.

firebaugh, run for it with attack formation (speed it up); if you get inside, your whole team follows you with defense. BigMedicMike, defend it with your best defensive heroes and gear. firebaugh, if you fail to take it, call a 1-min rally. All 3 of you there: reinforce yourselves with a full defensive march before you start attacking the Abbeys. firebaugh, after you hand the garrison to BigMedicMike, start burning enemy towns around you with your strongest march — Scervany helps you: attack the same target at the same time.
Attackers & defenders: send your secondary march to the closest Abbey (no teleport). Joiners: teleport as needed to gather loot from building flips.

PAPA, Scervany, MTP, firebaugh: teleport at 14:40 to the Sword Shrine and run for it as soon as it opens. If you get in, swap to defense, reinforce yourselves and send a defensive march back to the Sanctum you came from. If you fail to get in, call a 1-min rally.
Scervany & firebaugh: secondary march. Bell Tower team, help out with your secondary march!
PAPA & MTP: secondary march. Royal Stables team, help out with your secondary march!
Defenders keep their secondary march at the closest Abbey (no teleport).
